description: Error mitigation techniques implemented and applied

REM.name: Reference-State Error Mitigation
REM.description: Calibrates readout errors via assignment probability matrix. Raw counts corrected by matrix inversion.

ZNE.name: Zero-Noise Extrapolation
ZNE.description: Gate folding with scale factors [1,2,3] and Richardson extrapolation.

SQD.name: Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization
SQD.description: Filters QPU bitstrings by particle number + spin parity, diagonalizes in selected subspace.
SQD.applied_to: Rigetti Cepheus H2, LiH, BeH2 (4096 shots each)
